title: Shinonome Ena — In Excruciating Twilight〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom, where's that deodorizing spray I asked you to get the other day?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Maybe she's in the tub.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, it should be around here somewhere. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Aha, there you are!
Scentless deodorizing spray!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still...
*Sigh*
This whole grilled squid thing is such a pain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
They're not cute or photogenic.
Plus, they make your clothes smell.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I should've worn my gym clothes when making them since I was one slipup away from having to get my uniform dry-cleaned.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I don't want any of that sauce to get on my gym clothes either...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which I guess means the best option is to wear this hideous shirt...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The more I look at it, the dumber it feels.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, the font and stuff do go with the idea of us making “seriously good” grilled squid...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we really couldn't have gone with something better?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you're back...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. I am...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, wait! My shirt...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Was that your class's shirt?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if it was...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nothing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What is it...?
If you have something to say, then just say it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, you sure?
Then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't believe how lame it is.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
For your information!
I'm not happy with this shirt either!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, is that so?
You have my condolences.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That means your class came up with a pretty great shirt design, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If yours turns out to be lame too, I'm gonna paste it all over social media.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, be my guest.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the very least, the shirt my class came up with stinks a lot less than that one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You! Are! The! Worst!!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're the one who said I could say whatever's on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shut up! You can go away now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, I'll go once my tea's ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why did he have to see this dumb shirt?!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's it. I'm gonna make sure no one else sees it by cramming it in the bottom of my bag.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I accidentally brought home the spices and stuff everyone asked me to buy for the stall!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's so bad about that? The festival's tomorrow, so just take them with you to school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But I kinda felt like skipping it...
Now I have to go.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, if you agree to take these over for me, then I'll give you my dessert.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, he's gone...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess I don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I need to let Mizuki know that I'm going now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll send over a message later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talk about bad luck...
